title: Passive voice: forms and tenses
titleVi: Câu bị động: các dạng và thì
summary: Hệ thống toàn bộ dạng bị động theo thì và cấu trúc, kèm cách dùng trong văn phong học thuật Task 1 và Task 2.
whyItMatters: Văn phong học thuật ưu tiên bị động khi tác nhân không quan trọng: *The data were collected over six months.* Task 1 gần như bắt buộc dùng bị động để mô tả quy trình, còn Task 2 dùng bị động để giữ giọng khách quan. Dùng sai thì của `be` là lỗi phổ biến nhất.

sections.heading: Why and how: be + past participle
body: The passive is **be + past participle**. The object of an active verb becomes the subject: *They built the bridge in 1998* → *The bridge was built in 1998*.
Use the passive when the agent is unknown, obvious, unimportant, or when the process matters more than the person: *The samples were analysed at a certified laboratory.*
Add **by + agent** only when the agent carries information: *The report was commissioned by the ministry.* If the agent is **people**, **they** or **somebody**, drop it entirely.

examples.right: The samples were analysed at a certified laboratory.
The report was commissioned by the ministry.
The new rules will be introduced next term.
examples.wrong: People will introduce the new rules next term.
examples.note: Chủ ngữ không xác định **people** → nên dùng bị động.

sections.heading: The full tense grid
body: Only the verb **be** changes tense; the past participle never does. Learn the grid as one unit rather than tense by tense.
Perfect continuous forms (**have been being done**) are avoided in practice — rewrite them actively or with a different structure.

sections.heading: Passive with infinitives and modals
body: After a modal or **be going to**, use **be + V3**: *The site must be inspected*, *The stadium is going to be rebuilt*.
After certain verbs, use the passive infinitive **to be + V3**: *The results need to be verified*, *The form is expected to be signed today*.

For a past obligation or possibility, use the perfect passive infinitive **to have been + V3**: *The equipment should have been serviced months ago*, *The letter might have been sent to the wrong address.*

examples.right: The site must be inspected before construction begins.
The results need to be verified independently.
The equipment should have been serviced months ago.
examples.note: Perfect passive infinitive **to have been + V3**.

examples.right: The stadium is going to be rebuilt next year.
examples.wrong: The stadium is going to rebuilt next year.

sections.heading: Special structures: two objects, being done, get-passive
body: Verbs with two objects — **give, offer, pay, show, tell, ask** — allow either object to become the subject. Starting with the person is far more natural: *I was offered the job* rather than *The job was offered to me*.
After prepositions and verbs like **like, hate, remember, avoid**, use **being + V3**: *I don't like being told what to do*, *She left without being seen*.

The **get**-passive (**get + V3**) is informal and limited to things that happen to people: *Nobody got hurt*, *I don't get invited to these meetings*. It cannot express states — *Jessica is liked by everybody*, never *gets liked*. Note that **get married**, **get dressed**, **get lost** and **get changed** are not passives at all.
**I was born** is always past. The present passive **are born** appears only in general statements: *How many babies are born every day?*

examples.note: Person as subject of a two-object verb — the natural choice.

examples.right: I don't like being told what to do.
examples.note: **being + V3** after a verb of feeling.

examples.right: Nobody got hurt in the accident.

examples.note: **Born** dùng ở quá khứ khi nói về bản thân.

sections.heading: Passive in IELTS Task 1 and Task 2
body: Task 1 process diagrams require the passive throughout: *The beans are washed, dried and then roasted at 200 degrees.*
For data description, mix active and passive rather than using passive exclusively: *The figure rose sharply* is better than *A sharp rise was seen in the figure* when the subject is simple.
In Task 2, passive keeps the tone impersonal: *It is widely argued that..., Measures must be taken to...* But do not let it hide your reasoning — an essay of pure passive sentences reads as evasive.
Avoid the doubled passive that Vietnamese learners often produce by translating **được** mechanically: *The problem was been solved* is not English.

examples.right: The beans are washed, dried and then roasted at 200 degrees.
It is widely argued that university fees discourage poorer students.
Measures must be taken to reduce plastic waste.
examples.note: Modal passive in a Task 2 recommendation.

commonMistakes.wrong: The data was been collected last year.
commonMistakes.right: The data were collected last year.
commonMistakes.why: Không kết hợp `was` với `been`. Bị động quá khứ đơn chỉ là `was/were + V3`; `have/has been` chỉ dùng cho thì hoàn thành.

commonMistakes.wrong: The stadium is going to rebuilt next year.
commonMistakes.right: The stadium is going to be rebuilt next year.
commonMistakes.why: Sau `going to` phải có `be + V3`. Người Việt hay bỏ `be` vì dịch trực tiếp 'sẽ được xây lại'.

commonMistakes.wrong: The problem was solved by people.
commonMistakes.why: Không cần `by people/they/somebody` — tác nhân chung chung thì bỏ hẳn.
`Born` khi nói về bản thân luôn ở quá khứ; chỉ dùng `are born` cho câu khái quát như `How many babies are born every day?`
Sau `being` phải là `past participle` (V3), không dùng `past simple`.

ieltsTips: Task 1 mô tả quy trình nên dùng bị động xuyên suốt: `The mixture is heated and then cooled.`
Trong Task 2, dùng `It is widely argued that...` hoặc `Measures must be taken to...` để giữ giọng khách quan.
Đừng lạm dụng bị động: câu chủ động với chủ ngữ đơn giản (`The figure rose sharply`) thường rõ ràng hơn.
Kiểm tra thì của `be` trước khi viết — đây là lỗi phổ biến nhất khi dùng bị động trong bài thi.

exercises.question: The data ___ collected over six months last year.
exercises.explanation: **Data** là số nhiều trong văn phong học thuật, quá khứ đơn bị động → **were collected**.

exercises.question: The stadium is going to ___ next year.
Which sentence leaves out an unimportant agent correctly?
options: The problem was solved by people.
The problem is solved by they.
exercises.explanation: Tác nhân chung chung (**people/they**) thì bỏ; **was been** là sai.

exercises.question: The equipment should ___ months ago.
exercises.explanation: Bị động hoàn thành dạng động từ khuyết thiếu: **should have been + V3**.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses 'born' correctly?
exercises.explanation: **Born** khi nói về bản thân dùng quá khứ: **I was born**.

exercises.question: The samples ___ (analyse) at a certified laboratory last week.
exercises.explanation: Bị động quá khứ đơn: **were + V3**.

exercises.question: The new rules ___ (introduce) next term.
exercises.explanation: Bị động tương lai: **will be + V3**.

exercises.question: I don't like ___ (tell) what to do.
The results need ___ (verify) independently.
exercises.explanation: Bị động dạng động từ nguyên mẫu: **to be verified**.

exercises.question: The beans ___ (wash) and then roasted at 200 degrees.
exercises.explanation: Mô tả quy trình dùng bị động hiện tại đơn: **are washed**.
